Question: Ii am doing CA {chartered accountant}.is it right to practice as chartered accountant. Is the income from that profession is halal. Is it good to practice as CA or to do job in company is good? Answer ID: 2296 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1213/954=H) The right way to earn halal livelihood is to work with honesty and sincerity refraining to disobey the Shariah in any matter; whether you work as chartered accountant or do a job in a company. However, if you have doubt regarding any specific matter, write it clearly and correctly to us, we shall try to give you the solution. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
